description: In the live preview, let me hide or show individual pieces, e.g. hide the top plate or a housing to see how the gears mesh inside, without needing the full exploded view. Use a per-part visibility toggle (eye icon) in a parts list, plus optional 'isolate this part', and keep it working with the open/close animation so I can watch the gears move. Related: voice-a5d65841 (per-part version pickers, same preview UI).
summary: The live preview needs a parts list with per-part eye-icon visibility toggles, so users can hide pieces like the top plate or a housing. Hidden parts must stay hidden during the open/close animation, with an optional "isolate this part" action, so the gears can be watched meshing.
